messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] high error rate detected for delta-medical/vpc-staged rollout slice. 500s spike >5% across the slice, auto-page oncall.

oncall-matt: ack @channel, paging in. grabbing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-rollout-issues

jordan-eng: noted. can we confirm whether this is limited to the staged slice or bleeding to stable pools?

lia-customer-sre: lia (Delta Medical): we see ~8% 500 responses in logs starting 12:03 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/infer, /v1/embeddings. sample curl errors:
```bash
curl -v https://api.delta-medical.test/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' 
> HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{ "error": "kv-cache-mismatch" }
```

sara-platform: suggest immediate mitigation: pin delta-medical tenant to previous artifact and divert staged slice traffic to stable pool. pin command below:
```bash
redwood tenant pin --tenant delta-medical --artifact sha:abc123 --reason "staged rollout failure"
```

oncall-matt: running pin now.

deploy-bot: Pin job submitted: job_id=rb-pin-78234, applying artifact sha:abc123 to tenant=delta-medical. ETA ~25s.

deploy-bot: Pin job complete: job_id=rb-pin-78234, status=success, pinned_artifact=sha:abc123

oncall-matt: pinned and confirmed. starting traffic divest to stable-1 pool: `redwood traffic move --tenant delta-medical --from staged-slice --to stable-1 --weight 100`

deploy-bot: Traffic move job queued: job_id=rb-traffic-99087. monitor with `redwood jobs status rb-traffic-99087`

lia-customer-sre: seeing error rate drop: now 1.2% on sampled traces. Thanks — our downstream alerts are quieting.

jordan-eng: good. still want to isolate the staged slice to prevent any config propagation. running quarantine:
```bash
redwood slice quarantine --slice staged-slice --reason "contain regression for delta-medical"
```

sara-platform: quarantine applied. slice staged-slice is quarantined, no new allocations will be scheduled. quarantine_id=q-4456

oncall-matt: TL;DR: pinned tenant -> rolled traffic to stable -> quarantined staged slice. Customer impact reduced. proposing 1h watch, then postmortem and PR revert if confirmed root cause.

eng-sre-alex: taking 1h watch. created incident INC-2026-0452 in tracker with actions and timeline. looping in eng-runtime for RCA.

lia-customer-sre: appreciate the quick action. can you confirm whether the canary config will be adjusted before next rollout?

jordan-eng: initial suspect: tokenizer micro-opt introduced a KV cache edge-case. opening PR to revert: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/9876. Will request post-deploy smoke tests tightened on rollout config.

oncall-matt: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with the incident summary and expected RCA ETA ~24-48h. marking incident as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
